zoning_decision_clock.text: Governing body must act on zoning ordinance or map amendments within a reasonable time not exceeding 12 months, unless the applicant requests or consents to a longer period or withdraws.

special_exceptions.text: Zoning ordinance may provide for special exceptions; the governing body may reserve the right to issue them.

site_plan_clock.text: Local agent acts on site plans within 40 days of official submission and on resubmissions within 30 days; state agencies review within 30 days; a late decision on a resubmission is deemed approved.

conformity_review_clock.text: Public utility facilities not shown on the comprehensive plan need a planning commission 'substantially in accord' finding; failure to act within 60 days is deemed approval unless the governing body extends the time; appeal to the governing body within 10 days.

air_permit_clock.text: DEQ notifies completeness status within 30 days; processing is normally 90 days after a complete application, 180 days if a public hearing is required; extendable if information is needed.

rules.trigger_note: Applies before approval of a rezoning, special exception or special use permit for a new facility the applicant anticipates will need 100 MW or more from a retail utility. Expansions under 100 MW on approved sites are exempt.
requires: Sound-profile assessment on residential units and schools within 500 ft of the property boundary
Utility form describing new or existing substations and anticipated transmission voltage

rules.trigger_note: Construction or operation of a new stationary source requires a permit first; DEQ's 2025 data-center guidance (Clarifications 2025-01/02/03, APG-578) covers aggregation of phased construction within about five years, adjacency, and emergency-use conditions.
Prime on-site generation (turbines, engines, fuel cells) is a larger permit than emergency generators; a public hearing raises the statutory processing norm from 90 to 180 days.

start_after_months.note: Utility files after its feasibility study selects a solution

duration.note: Dominion: as little as 8 months uncontested; 12 to 24 months for complex cases. DEQ coordinated report due within 60 days of filing.
